source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.

line-flow-interval-form.reason: Exploratory Back/EXE sequence left Number Line and opened Dice instead of the intended interval editor; explicit HOME navigation measured the intended form in subsequent accepted frames.

observations: Bounds store expressions on EXE; Confirm evaluates them and reports Syntax/Range errors. Error dismissal selects the first bound and preserves expressions.
EXE/OK opens stored bound text at its beginning. AC clears only the draft, Back cancels it. DEL on the selected bound is ignored.
View-Window EXE/OK opens empty numeric input; EXE on empty input ignored, Back restores previous numeric value. Syntax/Math errors preserve draft and end cursor.
After fixing center 1+ to 1, the plot uses center 1; a subsequent 1/0 scale edit gives Math ERROR and can be edited again.
Finite intervals clipped by the viewport have no ray arrows at clipped edges. A left ray keeps its left arrow when its finite bound is beyond the right viewport; the finite side is clipped as a line.
Left arrow horizontal position and line overlap verified with visible/outside bound and with both bold selected and faint unselected ray.
